finding: `taskflow close` can block an active task with `ATM_TASK_QUEUE_HEAD_REQUIRED` from a stale or abandoned batch/task queue even when `batch status` and `tasks queue status` both report no active queue.
expectedBehavior: Close gating should derive queue-head requirements from one canonical active queue store. Completed, skipped, abandoned, or status-inactive batch runs must not block unrelated closeback, and official `batch skip` / `tasks queue abandon` receipts should be consumed consistently by every close gate.
evidenceOrRepro: During TASK-GIT-0028 close on 2026-07-29, `taskflow close --historical-delivery 48c6111... --write` failed with `ATM_TASK_QUEUE_HEAD_REQUIRED` naming queue `queue-48d9469c580f56e6` and head `ATM-GOV-0237`. In the same state, `node atm.mjs batch status --actor codex-git-series-captain --batch batch-97d04a6e4bca --json` returned no active batch and `node atm.mjs tasks queue status --json` returned `ATM_TASK_QUEUE_EMPTY`. The completed `.atm/runtime/batch-runs/batch-97d04a6e4bca.json` also recorded all queue heads as skipped. Official `tasks queue abandon --queue queue-48d9469c580f56e6 --actor codex-git-series-captain --json` was required before close could proceed.
followUp: Add a single queue-resolution facade used by next, batch status, tasks queue, and taskflow close. Regression should cover a completed batch with skipped heads plus done/released tasks retaining historical direction-lock queue metadata; close for a non-queued active task must not be blocked.
